comment: Example ~/.flowcore/ai.json configuration for FlowCore AI providers

_comment_providers.ollama_url: Primary Ollama endpoint (e.g., desktop PC over LAN)
_comment_providers.ollama_fallback_url: Fallback Ollama endpoint (e.g., phone running Ollama)
_comment_providers.openai_url: OpenAI-compatible endpoint URL (e.g., LM Studio, Jan, Hermes Agent)
_comment_providers.deepseek_url: DeepSeek API endpoint for news headline translation (cost-effective, fast)

_notes: One endpoint is enough; FlowCore tries them in priority order:
3. Primary Ollama for general LLM tasks
4. Fallback Ollama (e.g., phone) for when primary is down
Each missing provider is skipped — if none are configured, chat/briefing gracefully degrade.
Copy this file to ~/.flowcore/ai.json and edit with your actual endpoints & API keys.
